{{Quote|Trade Federation forces dead ahead. Protect the settlement.|Naboo commando to Lt. [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''</ref>}}
A '''research station''' was operated by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. It was used to research the next generation of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The facility was effectively destroyed following a [[Attack on the Trade Federation Research Station|raid]] by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].

==Description==
A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] research facility was built on an island. The buildings were surrounded by a high wall and guarded by three [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]].

A [[Security hangar|hangar]] for aerial vehicles was on a nearby island.

==History==
===Security Forces raid===
After acquiring intelligence on the facility, a contingent of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] [[Attack on the Trade Federation Research Station|raided and seized]] the facility. While the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] downloaded the data, Sykes used his [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] to defend them, as the Trade Federation did not take the raid lightly. The Federation sent a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] full of battle droids to retake the station. A number of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] engaged Sykes while scores of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPS]] harassed the defenders. Eventually, the overwhelming forces drove the commandos to call for an evacuation. A [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] landed on the remains of the station and recovered the commandos and the data. Droid starfighters pursued the fleeing ship until it reached escape velocity.

When the data was analyzed, it was found that the Federation was building an [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|advanced battle droid]].

==Behind the scenes==
The research station appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' during the first bonus mission. The mission is unlocked after acquiring all bronze medals during the campaign or through the use of cheat codes.
